narrative.weekly_mirror: This week, having influence over how things go showed up most clearly in the client call: when Pieter spoke over you and redirected the conversation, you “corrected him this time,” though it “came out sharper than I meant and the client noticed.” Away from work, Sunday brought a quieter space—“House to myself,” coffee made slowly, and time looking at the garden—alongside the unfinished thought about calling your brother.
narrative.tension_explanation: The earlier pattern of letting others take over your position did not continue in the same way in the client call, but asserting yourself carried its own discomfort and was visible to the client. The Sunday entry offers less context about how having influence over how things go felt outside work, especially in the unfinished thought about your brother.
